tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normal red cell indices, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, possibly reflecting reactive changes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further evaluation for the cause of anemia (e.g., chronic disease, renal insufficiency, or acute blood loss) is recommended.
